name: plugin-updater
description: Keeps the Claude Code plugins of the folder you work in current: its project and local installs plus your user-scope ones. At session start, once a day per folder by default, it runs the updater detached: refreshes the marketplaces and runs claude plugin update one install at a time for each install behind its marketplace clone; the next session shows one line with what changed or needs you. /plugin-updater:update-plugins runs it on demand; --all covers every project folder, --dry-run lists only, --last shows the last background run. It never accepts a changed marketplace command, and skips missing folders and git worktrees. Each switch is a /config option.

cc_plugin_updater_auto.title: Update in the background (CC_PLUGIN_UPDATER_AUTO)
cc_plugin_updater_auto.description: At session start, when the folder's last completed run is older than the interval, run the updater detached for that folder and user scope and report it at the next session start: on or off. Off leaves only a startup line counting outdated installs. The environment variable CC_PLUGIN_UPDATER_AUTO overrides this.

cc_plugin_updater_interval.title: Hours between background runs (CC_PLUGIN_UPDATER_INTERVAL)
cc_plugin_updater_interval.description: Minimum hours from a folder's last completed run to its next background run; 0 runs at every session start. The environment variable CC_PLUGIN_UPDATER_INTERVAL overrides this.

cc_plugin_updater_hint.title: Outdated-installs line (CC_PLUGIN_UPDATER_HINT)
cc_plugin_updater_hint.description: With background updates off, show a startup line counting outdated plugin installs: on or off. The environment variable CC_PLUGIN_UPDATER_HINT overrides this.
